facts.business: Shlokka Dyes Limited manufactures reactive dyes and other synthetic organic dyes (Direct, Basic, Vat, Digital Printing, Paper Dyes) and dye intermediates for textile, leather, paper, and paint industries.

capacity_or_capex.item: Additional spray dryer and vessels for light-shade dyes
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Rs 1.90 cr deployed by Mar 31 2026; balance Rs 4.22 cr expected in FY2026-27

guidance_or_targets.statement: Installed capacity expected to increase by 60-70% to 14,859 MTPA on full deployment of additional spray dryer

auditor.name: Patel & Panchal, Chartered Accountants (FRN 123744W)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: Company's net worth positive but has unsecured loans from directors; auditors confirm no uncertainty on going concern basis.

key_risks: Single spray dryer causes downtime when switching between dark and light shade dyes, limiting capacity utilisation
Deviation in utilisation of IPO proceeds (working capital excess utilisation, capex under-utilisation)
Penalty imposed by ROC for technical error in Form PAS-3 filing
facts.related_party_note: Company has accepted unsecured loans from directors and relatives of directors; acquisition of business undertaking of M/s Equinox Impex (sole proprietorship of Managing Director) agreed subsequent to year-end for Rs 3.67 cr.
